subject: Customer kickoff — 90-min workshop window, attendees, and access checklist
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@veridianhealth.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff — 90-min workshop window, attendees, and access checklist

Hi Alyssa / Samir,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the pilot — excited to get started. We want to lock a 90-minute kickoff workshop next week to align on goals, success criteria, data access, and the initial integration plan. Proposed windows (PDT):

- Tue 21 Jul, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 22 Jul, 13:00–14:30
- Thu 23 Jul, 09:00–10:30

Can you confirm which slot works, and who will attend from your side (PM, Security/IT, and an engineer are ideal)?

I've attached a compact agenda and a short network/access checklist we need completed before the call (IT will need to confirm firewall rules and service account permissions).

High-level agenda (attached "kickoff-compact-agenda.pdf"):
1) Introductions & success metrics (10m)
2) Architecture & data access requirements (25m)
3) Integration plan & first milestones (25m)
4) QA / next steps / owners (30m)

If you prefer a shorter 60-minute session, we can tighten the agenda — let me know.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kickoff-compact-agenda.pdf, network-access-steps.docx

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@veridianhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@veridianhealth.com>, IT Ops <it-ops@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — 90-min workshop window, attendees, and access checklist

Thanks Dylan — all sounds good. Wed 22 Jul 13:00–14:30 PDT works best for our team.

Attendees from Veridian:
- Alyssa Chen (PM, product)
- Samir Rao (Lead Engineer)
- Priya Varma (Security / Compliance) — copied via IT Ops entry; she may join from a separate dial-in.

Two quick asks from our side before the workshop:
1) Can you share the minimal list of service endpoints/ips our network team needs to allow?
2) Do you have a short pre-kickoff questionnaire for data classification?

Samir will follow up with IT Ops for the firewall entries.

—Alyssa
Product Manager, Veridian Health

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff — internal coordination / call staffing

Dylan — quick internal note.

I can own the section on success metrics and the rollout milestones. Karthik, can you take architecture and integration steps? Priyom, please prep the instrumentation checklist and a short demo script (5–7m) showing host-to-host connectivity and a sample inference flow.

I've attached a proposed attendee roster (attendee-roster.csv) with suggested talking points per Red team member. Also adding a separate checkbox list to the Drive resources to ensure IT has the exact ports/IPs they need.

Also: recommend we set up a short 20-min preflight with Veridian's IT (Samir / IT Ops) on Mon 21 Jul to confirm network entries before the main workshop. Do you agree?

—Monica
Senior Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: attendee-roster.csv

From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@veridianhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: IT Ops <it-ops@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — 90-min workshop window, attendees, and access checklist

Thanks — confirmed Wed 22 Jul 13:00–14:30 PDT. IT Ops will run the preflight on Mon 21 Jul 10:00–10:20 PDT (short hangout to validate firewall rules).

Samir (lead engineer) — quick answers to Dylan's two asks:
- Minimal endpoints: outbound to 52.23.112.0/24 (api.redwood-inference.com) and 34.210.98.55 for artifact fetch; allow TLS 443 outbound.
- Data classification questionnaire: we have a short internal doc, but if you can send a one-page template we can fill it and return.

IT Ops will also need the Zoom dial-in and any org-level SSO metadata if you intend to use SAML in the pilot (we don't require SSO for initial testing, just API keys).

—Samir
Lead Engineer, Veridian Health

Perfect — calendar invite sent for Wed 22 Jul 13:00–14:30 PDT (Zoom link below). Added the following items to the Drive folder (shared): kickoff-compact-agenda.pdf, attendee-roster.csv, network-access-steps.docx, demo-script.md.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abcd
Drive resources: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d_kickoff-resources
Preflight (IT): Mon 21 Jul 10:00–10:20 PDT — separate invite sent to IT Ops.

On the network front, Samir — thanks for the IP ranges; we'll include them in the network-access doc and ask IT to confirm by end of day Fri 17 Jul so we have time to loop if anything needs change.

Agenda summary (90-min):
- 13:00 — Quick intros & success criteria (Dylan / Alyssa)
- 13:10 — Architecture walkthrough (Karthik / Samir)
- 13:35 — Data access & security checklist (Priyom / Priya)
- 13:50 — Integration milestones & first 30 days (Monica)
- 14:10 — Q&A, open issues, owners & next steps

If Veridian prefers a mirrored recording-only link for compliance, we can enable recording (ask Priya during the call).

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

Dylan Brooks
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
